name: MKTG 6211
title: Multivariate Analysis in Marketing
description: This course provides an overview of multivariate statistical methods in marketing. Students learn multivariate statistical techniques such as discriminant, canonical, cluster, and factor analysis; multidimensional scaling; conjoint; and logit, probit, and tobit analysis. Students gain hands-on experience using these techniques for marketing applications.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
